manifest.name: external-identity
manifest.description: One external system's identifier for a record Accordo already owns, held beside that record rather than inside it. It stores the identifier and its provenance and never the source payload: no raw response, no credential and no secret is kept here.

migrations.name: create_external_identities

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_external_identities
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."external_identities" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "system" TEXT,
  "external_id" TEXT,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "subject_owner_package" TEXT,
  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'superseded')),
  "first_observed_run_id" TEXT,
  "last_observed_run_id" TEXT,
  "first_observed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "last_observed_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "external_identities_system"
  ON "accordo"."external_identities"("system");

CREATE INDEX "external_identities_external_id"
  ON "accordo"."external_identities"("external_id");

CREATE INDEX "external_identities_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."external_identities"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "external_identities_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."external_identities"("subject_id");

CREATE INDEX "external_identities_status"
  ON "accordo"."external_identities"("status");
